svg.title: Current native SQLite and PostgreSQL versus ULMDB VFS and FDW

cc:Work.dc:title: Current native SQLite and PostgreSQL versus ULMDB VFS and FDW
cc:Work.dc:description: Paired absolute throughput medians and trial min-max for all five SQL workloads, three SQLite value sizes and PostgreSQL64B. Six balanced trials, same filesystem within each pair. Includes regressions. Repeating32-byte digest values; SQLite native WAL/FULL versus ULMDB DELETE/FULL atomic page commits.

g.text: Same SQL within each pair · median throughput · higher is faster

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59707d

g.text: Bars: medians. Whiskers: trial min–max. Right: ULMDB ÷ native; small changes may fall within trial variation.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59707d

g.text: SQLite: native WAL/FULL vs ULMDB VFS DELETE/FULL atomic commits. PostgreSQL: fsync + synchronous_commit on; FDW external FULL sync.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59707d

g.text: Warm, one client · 1,000 rows/commit · IN batches of 100 · same /tmp filesystem for both comparators · native WAL auto-checkpoint enabled.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59707d

g.text: Values repeat a 32-byte SHA256 digest. Separate SHAKE256 high-entropy controls are one-trial diagnostics and are not plotted.
